newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares up at noon on strong sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares up at noon on strong sentiment.

text.p: Shanghai B shares surged at midday on Monday with investors snapping up blue chips and the Pudong real estate shares with sentiment boosted by the end of the annual reporting season, brokers said.
The B index gained 5.690 points or 6.24 percent to 96.909 points on volume of 25.494 million shares worth $14.935 million.

The three Pudong real estate shares traded the most actively mainly on domestic buying due to confidence in Pudong's economic development, brokers said, adding that overseas capital was also seen entering the market to buy blue chips.
"Overseas buying in blue chips indicated an optimistic outlook, which helped to further boost market sentiment," one broker said.
"The index will test the key 100-point resistance level in the short term if there is no major negative news," another broker said.
Of 43 B shares, 42 traded, with 37 up, two flat and three down.
Shanghai Worldbest was the star on good annual results, soaring $0.062 or 9.96 percent to $0.684 on volume of 866,900 shares.
Shanghai Narcisscus Electric Appliances Industry was the most actively traded share on institutional buying, up $0.008 or 3.99 percent to $0.208 on volume of 3.4 million shares.
Shanghai's A share index jumped despite negative news that the outstanding quota for new share issues had been raised by another five billion yuan, brokers said.
The index put on 44.270 points or 3.04 percent to 1,500.773 points on volume of 464.4 million shares worth 6.3 billion yuan.
The SSE30 blue chip index moved up 145.437 points or 3.65 percent to 4,134.787 points.
Shanghai Shuanglu Electric Appliances was the star on talk of financial restructuring, surging 0.83 yuan or 10.04 percent to 9.09 yuan on volume of 1.4 million shares.
